articles.title_en: Play to your strengths: Incumbency effect and issue emphasis in Brazilian local elections
articles.title_cn: 发挥你的优势：巴西地方选举中的在位效应与议题强调
articles.abstract_en: Incumbents’ reputations acquired during their time in office influence voters’ choices. Some studies suggest that, when designing their campaign messages, incumbents may benefit from playing to their strengths and emphasizing fewer issues than challengers. In this paper, I provide causal empirical evidence on this behavior using data from Brazilian mayoral elections and a regression discontinuity design. The findings indicate that marginal incumbents — those elected by a small vote margin — produce more concentrated campaign manifestos than challengers who narrowly lost. Moreover, incumbents belonging to cohesive and programmatic parties tend to emphasize party-specific issues more strongly, suggesting that reputation plays an important role in issue selection. To measure issue emphasis and manifesto concentration, I leverage a unique database of more than 28,000 political manifestos and apply a Latent Dirichlet Allocation (LDA) algorithm to estimate a vector of topics—or the issues emphasized by each candidate. Using this information, I calculate Herfindahl–Hirschman indices (HHI) to assess the degree of issue concentration in campaign manifestos.
articles.abstract_cn: 在位者在任期间获得的声誉会影响选民的选择。一些研究表明，在设计竞选信息时，在位者可能受益于发挥自身优势，并比挑战者强调更少的议题。在本文中，我利用巴西市长选举数据和断点回归设计，为这一行为提供了因果实证证据。研究结果表明，边缘在位者——即那些以微弱票数优势当选的候选人——比以微弱劣势落败的挑战者产生更为集中的竞选纲领。此外，属于具有凝聚力和纲领性政党的在位者往往更强烈地强调政党特定议题，这表明声誉在议题选择中发挥着重要作用。为了衡量议题强调和纲领集中度，我利用了一个包含超过28,000份政治纲领的独特数据库，并应用潜在狄利克雷分配（LDA）算法来估计主题向量——即每位候选人强调的议题。利用这些信息，我计算了赫芬达尔-赫希曼指数（HHI），以评估竞选纲领中议题集中的程度。

articles.title_en: Effect of social information on competition choice
articles.title_cn: 社会信息对竞争选择的影响
articles.abstract_en: We examine how social information about competition choices influences individuals’ willingness to compete. Participants perform a real-effort task under both piece-rate and tournament incentives, and subsequently make competition choices in two rounds. Between rounds, we exogenously vary the information provided about others’ choices across three treatments. We find that social information about the proportion of participants who chose to compete in the first round significantly affects the willingness to compete in the second round. This effect is not driven by the salience of the incentive schemes. Observing a lower rate of competition among peers increases an individual’s propensity to enter the tournament. This evidence is consistent with predictions from a rational model of Bayesian learning, in which individuals strategically choose to compete based on their treatment-induced belief about the average ability of other participants.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了关于竞争选择的社会信息如何影响个体的竞争意愿。参与者在计件工资和锦标赛激励下完成一项真实努力任务，随后在两轮中做出竞争选择。在两轮之间，我们外生地改变三种处理中提供的关于他人选择的信息。我们发现，关于第一轮中选择竞争的参与者比例的社会信息显著影响第二轮中的竞争意愿。这种效应并非由激励方案的显著性驱动。观察到同伴中较低的竞争率会增加个体进入锦标赛的倾向。这一证据与贝叶斯学习的理性模型预测一致，在该模型中，个体根据其处理诱导的关于其他参与者平均能力的信念策略性地选择竞争。

articles.title_en: A structural neural autopilot analysis of social media use around the pandemic lockdown
articles.title_cn: 疫情封锁期间社交媒体使用的结构性神经自动驾驶分析
articles.abstract_en: This paper estimates a “neural autopilot” model of habit formation using individual-level data on posting behavior from a major Chinese social media platform before, during, and after the 2020 pandemic lockdown. The model yields interpretable parameter estimates for autopilot habit formation and demonstrates that, once habits are neuroscientifically formalized, changes in preferences are no longer required to explain observed behavioral changes. Moreover, the model provides a better fit to the data than both traditional state-dependent habit models and alternative reinforcement learning models. Our analysis further reveals that forced experimentation alone does not generate persistent habitual posting after the lockdown ends. Counterfactual experiments indicate that reducing the volatility of posting rewards, in conjunction with forced experimentation, can significantly strengthen habitual posting on social media. This finding highlights the importance of higher moments of the reward process in creating and sustaining habits.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文利用中国一家大型社交媒体平台在2020年疫情封锁前后及期间的个人发帖行为数据，估计了一个习惯形成的“神经自动驾驶”模型。该模型为自动驾驶习惯形成提供了可解释的参数估计，并表明一旦习惯在神经科学层面被形式化，就不再需要偏好变化来解释观察到的行为变化。此外，该模型比传统的状态依赖习惯模型和替代性强化学习模型对数据的拟合更好。我们的分析进一步揭示，仅靠强制实验本身并不能在封锁结束后产生持续的习惯性发帖。反事实实验表明，降低发帖奖励的波动性，并结合强制实验，可以显著增强社交媒体上的习惯性发帖。这一发现强调了奖励过程的高阶矩在创造和维持习惯中的重要性。

articles.title_en: Can we make trading less hazardous to investors’ wealth? Evidence from a choice between flat rates or commissions for financial services
articles.title_cn: 我们能否让交易对投资者财富的危害更小？来自金融服务的固定费率或佣金选择的证据
articles.abstract_en: We exploit a real-world setting at a German brokerage where some investors are forced to choose between two pricing schemes for trading and holding mutual funds: a flat-rate versus commissions (pay-per-use, via front-end loads and annual fees). Advisors provide a tariff recommendation based on clients’ potential cost savings. Most clients follow this recommendation; still, 41% fail to choose the cost-beneficial scheme, and 83% of them exhibit a pay-per-use bias. Biased choices are partly related to the underestimation of trading costs and expectation-based loss aversion. Our results bear implications for designing pricing schemes in the financial industry.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们利用德国一家经纪公司的真实环境，其中一些投资者被迫在两种交易和持有共同基金的定价方案之间进行选择：固定费率与佣金（按使用付费，通过前端销售费用和年费）。顾问根据客户潜在的成本节省提供费率建议。大多数客户遵循这一建议；然而，仍有41%的人未能选择成本效益方案，其中83%的人表现出按使用付费的偏见。有偏见的选择部分与低估交易成本和基于期望的损失厌恶有关。我们的结果对金融行业设计定价方案具有启示意义。

articles.title_en: Making organization’s cost salient: A natural field experiment
articles.title_cn: 使组织的成本变得突出：自然的现场实验
articles.abstract_en: We report findings from a natural field experiment conducted at a university in which staff members order stationery for work-related purposes online, and the university bears the entire cost. We randomize staff members into a treatment and a control group. Only the former observes the cost information in the online ordering interface. We find that displaying the organization’s cost did not change the ordering frequency, nor the quantity of requested items, conditional on the items being ordered (the intensive margin), but did reduce the variety of items ordered (the extensive margin). Overall, the intervention led to a significant reduction in stationery consumption, resulting in a 27% decrease in quantities and substantial cost savings for the university. Thus, individuals at least partially internalize the external effects of their actions when the organization’s cost is made salient.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们报告了在一所大学进行的自然实地实验的结果，其中工作人员在网上订购与工作相关的文具，而大学承担全部费用。我们将工作人员随机分为治疗组和对照组。只有前者观察在线订购界面中的费用信息。我们发现，显示组织的成本并没有改变订购频率，也没有改变所请求商品的数量，以订购的商品为条件（集约利润），但确实减少了订购商品的种类（粗放利润）。总体而言，干预措施显着减少了文具消耗，导致 27% 数量减少，并为大学节省了大量成本。因此，当组织的成本变得突出时，个人至少会部分地内化其行为的外部影响。

articles.title_en: Fertility and welfare under Demeny voting
articles.title_cn: Demeny 投票下的生育率和福利
articles.abstract_en: This paper analyzes the welfare implications of children’s enfranchisement within a political economy framework that emphasizes the trade-offs in public policy when the electorate includes different age groups. We derive the political equilibrium under Markov strategies and compare welfare under standard suffrage and suffrage that includes children, for both PAYG and fully funded social security systems. The franchise that maximizes welfare across demographic groups depends on the fertility rate in the economy. Policies chosen when all demographic groups have voting rights are Pareto-improving compared to those chosen under the standard voting rights system, which excludes children from the electorate, when the fertility rate is low, and Pareto-reducing when the fertility rate is high. This result is driven by the surplus or shortage of funds available to finance pensions, depending on the ratio of workers to retirees in the economy. The model produces a negative association between tax revenues and fertility rates, as well as between public pension spending and the share of parents, consistent with OECD data. The counterfactual analysis based on the model calibrated to match the distribution of the number of children per household in OECD countries indicates that children’s enfranchisement would improve the welfare of all generations in most OECD countries.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文在政治经济框架内分析了儿童选举权对福利的影响，该框架强调当选民包括不同年龄组时公共政策的权衡。我们得出了马尔可夫策略下的政治均衡，并比较了标准选举权和包括儿童选举权下的福利，无论是现收现付制还是全额资助的社会保障制度。实现人口群体福利最大化的特许权取决于经济中的生育率。与标准投票权制度下选择的政策相比，当所有人口群体都拥有投票权时选择的政策是帕累托改进的，标准投票权制度在生育率低时将儿童排除在选民之外，而在生育率高时则选择帕累托缩减。这一结果是由可用于支付养老金的资金过剩或短缺造成的，具体取决于经济中工人与退休人员的比例。该模型显示税收收入与生育率之间以及公共养老金支出与父母比例之间存在负相关关系，这与经合组织的数据一致。基于与经合组织国家每户儿童数量分布相匹配的模型进行的反事实分析表明，儿童的选举权将改善大多数经合组织国家各代人的福利。

articles.title_en: The stability of self-control in unstable times
articles.title_cn: 不稳定时期自我控制的稳定性
articles.abstract_en: This paper examines the stability of self-control over time using nationally-representative longitudinal data from Australia. We track the same individuals between 2019 and 2023, a period encompassing one of the most disruptive global crisis in recent history: the COVID-19 pandemic. Despite these extraordinary circumstances, self-control remained remarkably stable: its mean and distribution were unchanged, and individuals largely preserved their relative positions. Within-person changes were small, and unrelated to variations in state-level exposure to both the spread of the virus and the policy responses that ensued. The evidence we report suggests that self-control is a deeply rooted, trait-like characteristic that persists even under extreme societal stress.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文使用澳大利亚具有全国代表性的纵向数据研究了自我控制随时间的稳定性。我们追踪 2019 和 2023 之间的同一个人，这一时期包含 一 近代史上最具破坏性的全球危机：新冠肺炎 19 大流行。尽管存在这些特殊情况，自我控制仍然非常稳定：其平均值和分布没有变化，个人在很大程度上保持了他们的相对地位。人体内的变化很小，并且与州一级暴露于病毒传播和随后的政策反应的变化无关。我们报告的证据表明，自我控制是一种根深蒂固的、类似特质的特征，即使在极端的社会压力下也会持续存在。

articles.title_en: Effects of debt exposure on self-employment: Evidence from US local markets in the Great Recession
articles.title_cn: 债务风险对自营职业的影响：来自大衰退时期美国本土市场的证据
articles.abstract_en: A significant increase in household debt occurred in the United States before the Great Recession. This study examines variations in debt-to-income ratios across local areas at the onset of the recession to understand how exposure to debt affected unincorporated self-employment and its average income during and after the downturn. It shows that the adverse effects of the recession on self-employment outcomes were more pronounced in areas that experienced larger household debt shocks. Furthermore, analysis of the following years indicates that the impact on self-employment persisted for a few more years after the recession ended.
articles.abstract_cn: 在大衰退之前，美国家庭债务大幅增加。本研究考察了经济衰退开始时各地区债务与收入比率的变化，以了解债务敞口如何影响经济衰退期间和之后的非法人自营职业及其平均收入。它表明，在家庭债务冲击较大的地区，经济衰退对自营职业结果的不利影响更为明显。此外，对随后几年的分析表明，对自营职业的影响在经济衰退结束后还持续了几年。

articles.title_en: Does having daughters affect political preferences? Using meta-analytic tools on many surveys
articles.title_cn: 有女儿会影响政治偏好吗？使用元分析工具对多项调查进行分析
articles.abstract_en: This study investigates whether having daughters impacts political preferences and whether this effect varies across European countries. We estimate effect sizes for 39 countries in the European Social Survey (n = 156,236) and aggregate estimates using random-effects meta-analysis, following a preregistered analysis plan. We find significant evidence that having daughters increases the preference for gender equality and homosexual rights. However, the meta-analytic effect size estimates are small, with 2.6% (95% CI [1.0%, 4.3%]) and 1.9% (95% CI [0.8%, 3.0%]) of a standard deviation, respectively. The meta-analytic effects of having daughters on left-right political preferences and preferences for reduced income inequality are statistically indistinguishable from zero. The heterogeneity in the effects of having daughters across countries is low, with zero to small heterogeneity for three outcome measures and small to moderate heterogeneity for left-right political preferences, consistent with high generalizability of results across the included countries.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究探讨有女儿是否会影响政治偏好，以及这种影响在欧洲各国之间是否存在差异。我们根据预先注册的分析计划，估计了欧洲社会调查中39个国家的效应量（n = 156,236），并使用随机效应元分析汇总估计值。我们发现显著证据表明，有女儿会增加对性别平等和同性恋权利的偏好。然而，元分析效应量估计值较小，分别为标准差的2.6%（95%置信区间[1.0%, 4.3%]）和1.9%（95%置信区间[0.8%, 3.0%]）。有女儿对左右政治偏好和减少收入不平等偏好的元分析效应在统计上与零无显著差异。有女儿的影响在不同国家间的异质性较低，三个结果指标的异质性为零到小，左右政治偏好的异质性为小到中等，这与结果在所包含国家中的高度可推广性一致。

articles.title_en: Origin country information and immigrant behavior: Evidence from the COVID-19 pandemic in the U.S
articles.title_cn: 来源国信息与移民行为：来自美国COVID-19大流行的证据
articles.abstract_en: Immigrants consume information from both their origin and destination countries. I examine how they adjust their behavior in response to new developments in their origin country by exploiting the timing of COVID-19 outbreak in each origin country. I find that as COVID-19 spread in various countries, immigrants from these countries were more likely to practice social distancing in the United States. Additionally, they reacted more strongly to new developments of COVID-19 in their origin countries after the declaration of a national emergency in the U.S., indicating immigrants’ actions are influenced by both information from their origin countries and the relevance of such information in their current country of residence. These behavioral changes are likely driven by real-time transmission of information through social media and other online channels.
articles.abstract_cn: 移民同时消费来自其来源国和目的地国的信息。我利用各来源国COVID-19暴发的时间来考察他们如何根据来源国的新动态调整自身行为。我发现，随着COVID-19在各国传播，来自这些国家的移民在美国更有可能实行社交距离。此外，在美国宣布国家紧急状态后，他们对来源国COVID-19新动态的反应更为强烈，这表明移民的行为既受到来源国信息的影响，也受到此类信息在当前居住国相关性的影响。这些行为变化可能由通过社交媒体和其他在线渠道的实时信息传播所驱动。

articles.title_en: Add-on selling with context effects
articles.title_cn: 具有情境效应的附加销售
articles.abstract_en: A common practice is to offer optional extras or upgrades during the purchase process. This paper studies endogenous consumer insensitivity to such additional prices: we posit that consumers are more prone to buy these overpriced extras when they represent a smaller share of total expenditure. The presence of such context-sensitive consumers softens competition in the market for the base good, jeopardizing their own surplus but also that of consumers with standard preferences. Exploitation of context effects by firms reduces total welfare.
articles.abstract_cn: 常见的做法是在购买过程中提供可选的附加功能或升级。本文研究了消费者对此类额外价格不敏感的内生性：我们假设，当消费者在总支出中所占份额较小时，他们更倾向于购买这些价格过高的额外产品。这种对环境敏感的消费者的存在削弱了基本商品市场的竞争，危及他们自己的剩余，也危及具有标准偏好的消费者的剩余。企业利用背景效应会降低总福利。

articles.title_en: An experimental analysis on cross-asset arbitrage opportunity and the law of one price
articles.title_cn: 跨资产套利机会与一价格规律的实验分析
articles.abstract_en: This study experimentally investigates the impact of the lack of arbitrage opportunities across different assets on the realization of the law of one price. Our experiment is based on the framework established by Charness and Neugebauer (2019) where participants, acting as traders, are involved in transactions with two different types of assets. We observe an increase in the magnitude of price discrepancies and fundamental mispricing when traders are unable to engage in arbitrage across assets.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究通过实验考察了不同资产缺乏套利机会对一价格规律实现的影响。我们的实验基于 Charness 和 Neugebauer (2019) 建立的框架，其中参与者作为交易者，参与 二 不同类型资产的交易。我们观察到，当交易者无法进行跨资产套利时，价格差异和基本面定价错误的程度就会加大。

articles.title_en: Does social media exacerbate political polarization? Experimental evidence from varying access to Twitter/X during a presidential debate
articles.title_cn: 社交媒体是否加剧了政治两极分化？总统辩论期间不同的 Twitter/X 访问方式的实验证据
articles.abstract_en: We study how variation in social media access (Twitter/X) during a salient political event affects political polarization and stress, and how these exposure effects relate to broader patterns of selection into social media. We conducted a pre-registered laboratory experiment during the 2019 Argentine presidential debate, recruiting both Twitter users and non-users. Twitter users were randomly assigned to one of four conditions: watching the debate with their usual phone access, watching the debate with their phones switched off, watching the debate while interacting with an experimenter-run Twitter account that shared a balanced mix of partisan content, or watching a politically neutral documentary without phones. Non-Twitter participants were randomly assigned to watch the debate or the documentary without phones. Selection comparisons indicate that recruited Twitter users are more polarized than recruited non-users. Causal exposure comparisons within the Twitter-user sample show that two strategies often proposed to reduce political polarization on social media, removing access to the platform and exposing users to counter-attitudinal content, do not reduce polarization and may instead produce mild increases. The latter treatment also significantly increases physiological stress (as measured by salivary cortisol). Further exploratory analyses reveal substantial heterogeneity tied to users’ online political environments. Politically segregated individuals — that is, users embedded in echo chambers — exhibit clear backfire effects when access is removed or cross-ideological interactions are encouraged. In particular, both treatments increase polarization among these users. In addition, when cross-ideological interaction is encouraged, segregated users concentrate a larger share of their Twitter engagement within like-minded networks and show higher cortisol levels. By contrast, non-segregated users show little to no response and closely resemble non-users. Moreover, the selection differences observed between recruited Twitter users and non-users in our sample are concentrated among politically segregated users.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究重大政治事件期间社交媒体访问（Twitter/X）的变化如何影响政治极化和压力，以及这些曝光效应如何与更广泛的社交媒体选择模式相关。我们在 2019 阿根廷总统辩论期间进行了一项预先注册的实验室实验，招募了 Twitter 用户和非用户。 Twitter 用户被随机分配到 四 个条件中的 一：用平常的手机访问观看辩论、关闭手机观看辩论、在与实验者运行的 Twitter 帐户（共享均衡的党派内容）互动的同时观看辩论，或者在不使用手机的情况下观看政治中立的纪录片。非 Twitter 参与者被随机分配在没有手机的情况下观看辩论或纪录片。选择比较表明，招募的 Twitter 用户比招募的非用户更加两极分化。 Twitter 用户样本中的因果暴露比较表明，通常提出的二策略是为了减少社交媒体上的政治极化、取消对平台的访问并使用户接触到相反态度的内容，但这些策略并不能减少极化，反而可能会产生轻微的增加。后一种治疗还显着增加生理压力（通过唾液皮质醇测量）。进一步的探索性分析揭示了与用户在线政治环境相关的巨大异质性。当访问被取消或鼓励跨意识形态互动时，政治隔离的个人（即嵌入回音室的用户）会表现出明显的适得其反的效果。特别是，这两种治疗方法都加剧了这些用户之间的两极分化。此外，当鼓励跨意识形态互动时，隔离的用户将更多的 Twitter 参与集中在志趣相投的网络中，并表现出更高的皮质醇水平。相比之下，非隔离用户几乎没有反应，并且与非用户非常相似。此外，在我们的样本中，在招募的 Twitter 用户和非用户之间观察到的选择差异集中在政治隔离的用户中。

articles.title_en: App security spillovers in the digital era: Immorality or ignorance?
articles.title_cn: 数字时代的应用程序安全溢出：不道德还是无知？
articles.abstract_en: We document how interactions between App producers affect App security, including both intentional security problems due to immorality and unintentional security problems due to ignorance. Exploiting a quasi-experiment that improves the security of some Apps, we find that a ten-percentage-point increase in the proportion of directly-treated Apps in the same county leads to a 1.6% improvement in App security of other Apps. Such spillover effects are stronger when information dissemination is more efficient, which supports information exchange as an important mechanism. Although spillover effects exist for both types of security problems, the effects are weaker for security problems that are intentional than unintentional ones, especially under high market competition pressure.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们记录了应用程序生产者之间的交互如何影响应用程序安全，包括由于不道德而导致的故意安全问题和由于无知而导致的无意安全问题。利用提高部分App安全性的准实验，我们发现，同县直接处理的App比例增加十个百分点，导致其他App的App安全性提高1.6%。当信息传播效率越高时，这种溢出效应就越强，从而支持信息交换作为一种重要机制。虽然两类安全问题都存在溢出效应，但有意的安全问题的影响要弱于无意的安全问题，特别是在市场竞争压力较大的情况下。

articles.title_en: Do managerial incentives facilitate anti-competitive behavior? Evidence from collusion
articles.title_cn: 管理激励是否会促进反竞争行为？共谋证据
articles.abstract_en: We examine whether executive pay structures encourage explicit collusion. This is particularly important as the manager determines the firm’s strategy. We link US cartel cases to executive remuneration and firm data for 1994–2017 to exploit variation in the long-term share of compensation using an instrumental variables estimation approach. Our results indicate that a larger share of long-term compensation increases both cartel participation and initiation. This is consistent with a mechanism in which long-term incentives tie managerial wealth to the continuation of profits above the competitive level and reduce gains from deviation. The effects are primarily driven by equity components. In particular, equity-based risk-taking incentives are positively associated with collusion. The results are more pronounced in less competitive industries and among more innovative firms. Our findings imply a governance trade-off: incentive schemes that better align managers with shareholders can raise the incentive to collude. For enforcement purposes, executive pay design is useful for screening and risk assessment.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究高管薪酬结构是否鼓励明显的共谋。当经理决定公司的战略时，这一点尤其重要。我们将美国卡特尔案件与 1994-2017 的高管薪酬和公司数据联系起来，利用工具变量估计方法来利用长期薪酬份额的变化。我们的研究结果表明，较大比例的长期薪酬会增加卡特尔的参与和发起。这与一种机制是一致的，在该机制中，长期激励将管理财富与持续高于竞争水平的利润联系起来，并减少偏离带来的收益。这些影响主要是由股票成分驱动的。特别是，基于股权的冒险激励与共谋呈正相关。在竞争力较弱的行业和创新性较高的公司中，结果更为明显。我们的研究结果意味着治理权衡：使管理者与股东更好地保持一致的激励计划可以提高共谋的动机。出于执行目的，高管薪酬设计有助于筛选和风险评估。

articles.title_en: Delegation of job design and imperfect performance measures
articles.title_cn: 工作设计的委派和不完善的绩效衡量
articles.abstract_en: Contemporary business practices are increasingly shifting from top-down job design towards bottom-up job crafting, empowering employees to take an active role in designing their jobs. This new type of delegation has been particularly accelerated by the COVID-19 pandemic, however, has not yet been studied from an organizational economics perspective which would allow to shed light on optimal delegation strategies for firms. We develop a multitask agency model featuring private information, moral hazard, and imperfect performance measurement to explore under which conditions the delegation of job design to an informed agent can be beneficial for the firm. Our findings suggest that delegation is preferable to a centralized job design when the performance measure used for contracting purposes is incongruent. Notably, under certain conditions, the principal can attain the same outcome through delegation as if the agent’s private information was observable ex ante.
articles.abstract_cn: 当代商业实践越来越多地从自上而下的工作设计转向自下而上的工作塑造，使员工能够在工作设计中发挥积极作用。 COVID-19大流行特别加速了这种新型授权，但尚未从组织经济学的角度进行研究，从而阐明企业的最佳授权策略。我们开发了一个多任务代理模型，以私人信息、道德风险和不完善的绩效衡量为特征，以探索在什么条件下将工作设计委托给知情代理对公司有利。我们的研究结果表明，当用于承包目的的绩效衡量标准不一致时，授权比集中式工作设计更可取。值得注意的是，在某些条件下，委托人可以通过委托获得相同的结果，就好像代理人的私人信息是事前可观察到的一样。

articles.title_en: Grabbing the forbidden fruit: Restriction-sensitive choice
articles.title_cn: 摘取禁果：限制敏感的选择
articles.abstract_en: Restricting individuals’ access to some opportunities may steer their desire toward their substitutes, a phenomenon known as the forbidden fruit effect. We axiomatize a choice model named restriction-sensitive choice (RSC), which rationalizes the forbidden fruit effect and is compatible with the prominent psychological explanations: reactance theory and commodity theory. The model is identifiable from choice data, specifically from the observation of choice reversals caused by the removal of options. We conduct a normative analysis both in terms of the agent’s freedom and welfare. We apply our model to shed light on two phenomena: the backfire effect of beliefs and the backlash of integration policies targeted toward minorities.
articles.abstract_cn: 限制个人获得某些机会可能会引导他们对替代品的渴望，这种现象被称为禁果效应。我们公理化了一个名为限制敏感选择（RSC）的选择模型，该模型合理化了禁果效应，并且与著名的心理学解释：电抗理论和商品理论兼容。该模型可以通过选择数据来识别，特别是通过观察因删除选项而导致的选择逆转。我们从代理人的自由和福利两个方面进行了规范分析。我们应用我们的模型来揭示二现象：信仰的适得其反效应和针对少数群体的融合政策的强烈抵制。

articles.title_en: Beauty premia in wage offers: Evidence from Vietnamese online job postings
articles.title_cn: 薪资中的美容溢价：来自越南在线招聘信息的证据
articles.abstract_en: We analyze a sample of nearly 40,000 gender-targeted online job vacancies in Vietnam from February 2019 to July 2020 to estimate wage offer premia for physical attractiveness and how they vary between genders. Specifically, we compare the monthly wages offered in matched vacancies with and without attractiveness requirements for job advertisements targeting men and women separately. Our estimates point to a gender asymmetry in how stated physical attractiveness preferences relate to posted wages: physically attractive women are offered higher salaries, whereas physically attractive men are not. Cross-sectional matching estimates place the premium for women at about five percentage points; specifications with firm fixed effects attenuate this magnitude but preserve the asymmetry. Further analysis reveals that gender differences in the wage offer premia to physical attractiveness are mainly driven by attitudes toward gender roles, employer characteristics, and perceived lack of fit, rather than by the potential productivity-enhancing effects of physical attractiveness in certain occupations.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们分析了从二月40,000到七月2019越南近2020个针对性别的在线职位空缺样本，以估计外貌吸引力的工资溢价及其在性别之间的差异。具体来说，我们分别比较了针对男性和女性的招聘广告中具有和不具有吸引力要求的匹配空缺职位提供的月工资。我们的估计表明，外表吸引力偏好与工资之间的关系存在性别不对称：外表有吸引力的女性可以获得更高的薪水，而外表有吸引力的男性则不然。横截面匹配估计显示女性的保费约为 五 个百分点；具有固定固定效应的规范会减弱这种幅度，但会保留不对称性。进一步的分析表明，工资中的性别差异对外表吸引力的影响主要是由对性别角色的态度、雇主特征和感知的不适应所驱动的，而不是由某些职业中外表吸引力的潜在生产力提高效应驱动的。

articles.title_en: When quality management helps agri-food firms to export
articles.title_cn: 当质量管理帮助农产品公司出口时
articles.abstract_en: This article examines the impact of firms’ quality policies on export performance. Using French administrative data at the employee and firm levels, we assess the level of firms’ commitment to issues related to product reliability and safety through the presence of quality management personnel. We merge these data with French customs data, which provide the value and quantity of exports for each firm by product and destination. We show that firms with quality management employees export higher volumes and have longer trade relationships, especially in non-European markets with stringent standards (higher number of sanitary and phytosanitary or technical measures). Overall, our paper highlights the role of agri-food firms’ ”quality investment” in export performance.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文探讨了企业质量政策对出口绩效的影响。使用法国员工和公司层面的管理数据，我们通过质量管理人员的存在来评估公司对产品可靠性和安全相关问题的承诺水平。我们将这些数据与法国海关数据合并，后者按产品和目的地提供每个公司的出口价值和数量。我们表明，拥有质量管理员工的公司出口量更高，贸易关系也更长，特别是在标准严格（卫生和植物检疫或技术措施较多）的非欧洲市场。总体而言，我们的论文强调了农产品公司的“优质投资”在出口绩效中的作用。

articles.title_en: Wealth, cost, and misperception: Empirical estimation of three interaction channels in a financial–macroeconomic agent-based model
articles.title_cn: 财富、成本和误解：基于金融宏观经济主体模型中三互动渠道的实证估计
articles.abstract_en: Financial–macroeconomic agent-based models offer a promising avenue for understanding complex economic interactions, but their empirical estimation is challenging, particularly when the relevant data are observed at different frequencies. We address this gap by developing a mixed-frequency adaptation of the simulated method of moments that evaluates macroeconomic and financial moment conditions at their native quarterly and daily frequencies within a single objective function. Applying it to a stylized integrated agent-based model on U.S. data from 1954 to 2025, we quantify three key interaction channels between the financial and real sectors. The stock market influences the real economy through the wealth effect on consumption and the cost effect on firms’ financing. Conversely, the real economy influences the stock market through a price-misperception effect that shapes fundamental valuations. Our results provide the first model-based empirical evidence that all three channels are statistically significant, offering novel insights into macro-financial dynamics.
articles.abstract_cn: 基于金融宏观经济主体的模型为理解复杂的经济相互作用提供了一条有前途的途径，但它们的经验估计具有挑战性，特别是当以不同频率观察相关数据时。我们通过开发矩模拟方法的混合频率适应来解决这一差距，该方法在单个目标函数内以其本地季度和每日频率评估宏观经济和金融矩条件。将其应用于基于1954至2025美国数据的程式化综合代理模型，我们量化了三金融和实体部门之间的关键互动渠道。股票市场通过对消费的财富效应和对企业融资的成本效应影响实体经济。相反，实体经济通过形成基本估值的价格误解效应影响股票市场。我们的结果提供了第一基于模型的经验证据，表明所有三渠道都具有统计显着性，为宏观金融动态提供了新颖的见解。

articles.title_en: The anti-corruption campaign and the intergenerational transmission of bureaucratic employment: Evidence from China
articles.title_cn: 反腐败运动与官僚雇佣的代际传递：来自中国的证据
articles.abstract_en: Inequality in bureaucratic employment, favoring individuals from bureaucratic family backgrounds, is widespread. Using China’s recent anti-corruption campaign as a quasi-experiment, we examine how intensified counter-corruption efforts reshape intergenerational occupational transmission within the public sector. Employing a difference-in-differences approach, we compare changes in the likelihood of bureaucratic employment for children of bureaucrats versus non-bureaucrats before and after the campaign implementation across provinces. Prior to the campaign, offspring of bureaucrats were over 13 percentage points more likely to work in the bureaucracy; following the campaign, this advantage diminished by more than 5 percentage points. Further analyses suggest that relatively better outside options for bureaucrats’ children serve as a mechanism, while alternative explanations, such as asymmetric insider information, shifts in risk preferences, or changes in perceptions of bureaucracy, are not supported by the data. Our findings highlight how anti-corruption initiatives can reduce entrenched dynastic privileges and promote greater equality of opportunity within public institutions.
articles.abstract_cn: 官僚就业不平等现象普遍存在，有利于来自官僚家庭背景的个人。我们以中国最近的反腐败运动作为准实验，研究加强反腐败努力如何重塑公共部门内的代际职业传播。我们采用双重差分法，比较了各省行动实施前后，官僚与非官僚子女在官僚就业的可能性的变化。竞选之前，官僚后代在官僚机构工作的可能性超过13个百分点；竞选结束后，这一优势缩小了 5 个百分点以上。进一步的分析表明，官僚子女相对更好的外部选择是一种机制，而数据不支持其他解释，例如内幕信息不对称、风险偏好的转变或对官僚观念的改变。我们的研究结果强调了反腐败举措如何减少根深蒂固的王朝特权并促进公共机构内更大的机会平等。

articles.title_en: Nurturing the future: How positive parenting is related to children’s skills and well-being
articles.title_cn: 培育未来：积极的养育方式与孩子的技能和福祉有何关系
articles.abstract_en: We study the relationship between maternal parenting style and a broad range of children’s skills and outcomes. Using survey and incentivized experimental data from 5644 children aged 6 to 16 and their parents, we find that children whose mothers are classified as practicing a positive parenting style score higher on IQ, are more altruistic, exhibit higher openness, conscientiousness, and agreeableness, and have a higher locus of control, self-control, and self-esteem. They also perform better in scholarly achievement tests, display more prosocial behavior in everyday life, and report higher life satisfaction. Additionally, positive parenting is negatively associated with children’s patience, neuroticism, engagement in risky behaviors, and their emotional and behavioral problems.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究母亲的养育方式与广泛的儿童技能和结果之间的关系。利用对5644至6岁16儿童及其父母的调查和激励实验数据，我们发现，母亲被归类为积极养育方式的孩子智商得分较高，孩子更加无私，表现出更高的开放性、尽责性和宜人性，并且具有更高的控制源、自控源和自尊源。他们在学业成绩测试中也表现得更好，在日常生活中表现出更多的亲社会行为，并且生活满意度更高。此外，积极的养育方式与孩子的耐心、神经质、冒险行为以及情绪和行为问题呈负相关。

articles.title_en: Exploring information provision to promote stem cell donation: Evidence from a field experiment of the Japan Marrow Donor Program
articles.title_cn: 探索促进干细胞捐赠的信息提供：来自日本骨髓捐赠计划现场实验的证据
articles.abstract_en: Registered potential donors in stem cell transplantation may refuse to donate when matched with patients, causing supply shortages. To reduce such donor dropout, we developed behavioral interventions comprising messages added into the letters sent when donors are matched with patients in Japan, and conducted a field experiment to evaluate the effect of our intervention. The results demonstrate that the inclusion of our messages can reduce donor dropout and increase donor availability for transplantation. Specifically, the message emphasizing the limited number of compatible donors per patient increased the probability of donors completing the confirmatory typing stage by 7.3%. Since physicians can choose the best donor for proceeding to donation from those who complete confirmatory typing, this message increases donor availability for transplantation.
articles.abstract_cn: 登记的干细胞移植潜在捐献者在与患者匹配时可能会拒绝捐献，导致供应短缺。为了减少这种捐赠者流失，我们开发了行为干预措施，包括在捐赠者与日本患者匹配时发送的信件中添加信息，并进行了现场实验来评估我们干预的效果。结果表明，纳入我们的信息可以减少捐赠者的流失并增加捐赠者进行移植的可能性。具体来说，强调每个患者的兼容捐献者数量有限的消息使捐献者完成确认打字阶段的概率增加了7.3%。由于医生可以从完成确认打字的人中选择最佳的捐赠者进行捐赠，因此此消息增加了移植捐赠者的可用性。

articles.title_en: Custodial versus non-custodial sentences: Long-run evidence from an anticipated reform
articles.title_cn: 监禁刑与非监禁刑：来自预期改革的长期证据
articles.abstract_en: We study the relative impact of custodial and non-custodial sentences on later convictions and labor-market outcomes in Denmark, a country where detention conditions are particularly good. To do so, we take advantage of a large-scale reform of the Danish legislation implemented in 2000, whereby incarceration was replaced by a non-custodial sentence for most drunk-driving crimes, which represented a quarter of all custodial sentences passed in 1999. Our first key finding is that stakeholders anticipated the consequences of the reform and that trials involving wealthier offenders were more likely to be postponed until after the reform came into force, which in turn reduced the likelihood of incarceration. To measure the relative impact of incarceration, we therefore use a novel instrumental variable approach exploiting quasi-exogenous variation in the probability of being tried after the reform, and therefore incarcerated, based on offenders’ crime date. We follow sampled individuals over a 15-year period and find that incarcerated offenders are convicted of more crimes and have weaker ties to the labor market after release. Additionally, first-time offenders and those with stronger ties to the labor market are more negatively affected.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了丹麦监禁刑与非监禁刑对后续定罪和劳动力市场结果的相对影响，丹麦是一个拘留条件特别好的国家。为此，我们利用了丹麦立法在2000年实施的大规模改革，其中大多数酒驾犯罪被非监禁刑取代，这些犯罪占1999年所有监禁刑的四分之一。我们的第一个关键发现是，利益相关者预见到了改革的后果，涉及较富裕罪犯的审判更有可能推迟到改革生效之后，这反过来降低了监禁的可能性。为了衡量监禁的相对影响，我们因此使用了一种新颖的工具变量方法，利用基于罪犯犯罪日期的改革后受审概率的准外生变化，从而被监禁。我们在15年期间跟踪了样本个体，发现被监禁的罪犯在释放后被判犯有更多罪行，并且与劳动力市场的联系较弱。此外，初犯者和与劳动力市场联系更紧密的人受到更不利的影响。

articles.title_en: Deferred training
articles.title_cn: 延期培训
articles.abstract_en: Standard human-capital theory predicts that firms invest in training early in a worker’s tenure to maximize the duration of returns. Yet in practice, training is often deferred to later stages of employment. This paper develops a unifying framework for understanding deferred training. We begin by establishing a benchmark result: in standard dynamic environments, firm-sponsored training is front-loaded. We then extend the framework to identify three conceptually distinct forces that can generate deferral: (1) productive efficiency, where training is delayed because later investment yields higher returns; (2) turnover management, where firms postpone training to mitigate mobility risk; and (3) poaching deterrence, where firms suppress early training to conceal information about worker ability. While the first mechanism is efficiency enhancing, the latter two reflect timing distortions. For each mechanism, we characterize the underlying logic, derive testable predictions, and draw implications for firm practice and public policy that promote timely skill development.
articles.abstract_cn: 标准人力资本理论预测，公司会在员工任职初期投资培训，以最大限度地延长回报期限。但在实践中，培训往往被推迟到就业的后期阶段。本文开发了一个理解延期培训的统一框架。我们首先建立一个基准结果：在标准的动态环境中，公司赞助的培训是前置的。然后，我们扩展该框架，以确定三概念上不同的力量，这些力量可以产生延迟：（1）生产效率，其中培训被延迟，因为后来的投资会产生更高的回报； (2) 人员流动管理，即公司推迟培训以降低流动风险； (3) 偷猎威慑，即公司压制早期培训以隐瞒有关工人能力的信息。虽然第一机制提高了效率，但后者二反映了时序扭曲。对于每种机制，我们描述了潜在的逻辑，得出可测试的预测，并得出对促进及时技能发展的公司实践和公共政策的影响。

articles.title_en: Suspicion and communication
articles.title_cn: 怀疑与沟通
articles.abstract_en: In this paper, we study how communication influences suspicion. The experiment uses a sender–receiver setup with a low probability of misaligned incentives for senders and receivers. We focus on the impact of open communication on the receivers’ suspicion as measured by the size of the deviation from the senders’ recommendation before and after the communication. Overall, communication substantially reduces suspicion, but some receivers become more suspicious during the communication. We disentangle these effects using machine learning methods to analyze the chat logs.
articles.abstract_cn: 在本文中，我们研究沟通如何影响怀疑。该实验使用发送者-接收者设置，发送者和接收者的激励不一致的可能性很低。我们关注开放式沟通对接收者怀疑的影响，通过沟通前后与发送者推荐的偏差大小来衡量。总体而言，沟通大大减少了怀疑，但一些接收者在沟通过程中变得更加怀疑。我们使用机器学习方法来分析聊天日志来理清这些影响。

articles.title_en: Using role models to inspire marginalized groups: A cautionary tale
articles.title_cn: 使用榜样来激励边缘群体：一个警示故事
articles.abstract_en: How can development programs reach geographically, politically, culturally, and economically isolated communities? We present experimental evidence on the impact of a role model intervention to inspire enterprise activity among ethnic minorities in Vietnam. We distinguish between relatable ethnic minority role models and ethnic majority role models to examine how increasing the social distance of a role model from the target population affects outcomes, while holding the information content constant. The intervention temporarily increased the locus of control of participants in the ethnic minority treatment, however, these effects were transient and faded over time. While behavioral responses were limited, we find some evidence that the social relatability of the role models was a slightly more important trigger for behavioral change than the information content. Ultimately, however, the limited effects of the treatments on enterprise activities did not translate into higher incomes for households at end-line. Overall, our findings provide a cautionary tale for the use of role models as a standalone intervention to generate sustained behavioral change.
articles.abstract_cn: 发展计划如何惠及在地理、政治、文化和经济上孤立的社区？我们提供了关于榜样干预对激发越南少数民族企业活动影响的实验证据。我们区分了相关的少数族裔角色模型和多数族裔角色模型，以研究在保持信息内容不变的情况下，增加角色模型与目标人群的社会距离如何影响结果。干预措施暂时增加了少数族裔治疗参与者的控制点，然而，这些影响是短暂的，并随着时间的推移而消失。虽然行为反应有限，但我们发现一些证据表明，榜样的社会相关性是行为改变的比信息内容稍微更重要的触发因素。然而，最终，这些待遇对企业活动的有限影响并没有转化为最终家庭的更高收入。总的来说，我们的研究结果为使用榜样作为独立干预措施来产生持续的行为改变提供了警示。

articles.title_en: The political returns to women’s inheritance rights in India
articles.title_cn: 印度妇女继承权的政治回报
articles.abstract_en: This paper examines whether granting property inheritance rights to women improves their participation in politics as election candidates in India. Leveraging state-level changes in inheritance laws and large-scale election data, we find that improved property rights increase female candidacy and their chances of winning elections. The reforms particularly encourage regional parties to nominate more women, with a notable rise in new female candidates. We show that these results are not confounded by pre-existing trends and are robust to treatment effect heterogeneity. We provide suggestive evidence that the rise in political participation stems from gains in women’s financial autonomy and shifts in restrictive gender norms due to the reforms. Our findings underscore the potential for legal and institutional reforms that expand women’s economic agency to generate meaningful political empowerment and reduce gender gaps in political representation.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文探讨了授予妇女财产继承权是否可以提高她们作为印度选举候选人的政治参与度。利用州级继承法的变化和大规模选举数据，我们发现财产权的改善增加了女性候选资格及其赢得选举的机会。这些改革特别鼓励地区政党提名更多女性，新女性候选人的数量显着增加。我们表明，这些结果不会与预先存在的趋势相混淆，并且对治疗效果异质性具有稳健性。我们提供了具有启发性的证据，表明政治参与度的提高源于妇女财务自主权的提高以及改革带来的限制性性别规范的转变。我们的研究结果强调了法律和制度改革的潜力，这些改革可以扩大妇女的经济机构，从而产生有意义的政治赋权并缩小政治代表性中的性别差距。

articles.title_en: Quality vs. quantity when time is scarce
articles.title_cn: 时间紧迫时的质量与数量
articles.abstract_en: How do consumers decide between quality and quantity, and what drives heterogeneity in quality choice? This paper introduces a tractable model of consumer choice in which quality sorting emerges endogenously from wage heterogeneity in the presence of time opportunity costs of consumption. Consumers must allocate more time to consume larger quantities, while quality allows consumers to increase utility without affecting their time budget constraints. The model predicts that higher-wage consumers choose higher quality while higher-wealth consumers choose higher quantity. This leads consumers to view quality and quantity as distinct concepts and offers a tractable alternative to discrete choice models, explicitly incorporating both dimensions.
articles.abstract_cn: 消费者如何在质量和数量之间做出决定，以及是什么导致了质量选择的异质性？本文介绍了一种易于处理的消费者选择模型，其中在存在消费时间机会成本的情况下，质量排序是从工资异质性中内生出现的。消费者必须分配更多的时间来消费更多的数量，而质量可以让消费者在不影响时间预算限制的情况下提高效用。该模型预测，高工资的消费者会选择更高的质量，而高财富的消费者会选择更高的数量。这导致消费者将质量和数量视为不同的概念，并为离散选择模型提供了一种易于处理的替代方案，明确地将这两个维度结合起来。

articles.title_en: COVID-19 and peer relationships: Insights from classroom social networks
articles.title_cn: COVID-19 和同伴关系：来自课堂社交网络的见解
articles.abstract_en: In the spring of 2020, as the COVID-19 pandemic swept across the globe, governments implemented drastic containment measures, including widespread school closures that deprived millions of children of their primary social environment—the classroom. To understand how classroom peer relationships differed between the pre-pandemic and pandemic cohorts, we leverage social network data from 3rd and 4th-grade students in Turkish primary schools, comparing pre-pandemic and pandemic cohorts across three relationship types: friendship, academic support, and emotional support. We document opposing changes across network types: friendship isolation increased by 22%, while academic support nominations rose by 20%. These improvements in academic support were driven entirely by native students; refugee students faced deterioration in both friendship and academic support networks. Our findings show that large-scale disruptions can reshape peer relationships in complex ways, underscoring the vital role of the classroom in building social capital.
articles.abstract_cn: 2020春天，随着新冠肺炎19大流行席卷全球，各国政府实施了严厉的遏制措施，包括大面积关闭学校，剥夺了数百万儿童的主要社会环境——教室。为了了解大流行前和大流行群体之间的课堂同伴关系有何不同，我们利用土耳其小学3和4年级学生的社交网络数据，比较大流行前和大流行群体的三关系类型：友谊、学术支持和情感支持。我们记录了跨网络类型的相反变化：友谊隔离增加了 22%，而学术支持提名增加了 20%。这些学术支持的改善完全是由本地学生推动的；难民学生的友谊和学术支持网络都面临恶化。我们的研究结果表明，大规模的破坏可以以复杂的方式重塑同伴关系，强调了课堂在建立社会资本方面的重要作用。

articles.title_en: Perseverance, cognitive skills and life outcomes
articles.title_cn: 毅力、认知技能和生活成果
articles.abstract_en: We study the early-life determinants of children’s perseverance and its predictive power for educational attainment and labour market outcomes across the life course. Using teacher-assessed perseverance from the 1970 British Cohort Study we document that cognitive skills, gender, early health, and parental influences (particularly maternal biological factors and paternal education) are the strongest predictors of perseverance at age 10. Perseverance and cognitive skills exhibit distinct yet complementary effects on later outcomes. Perseverance shows strong associations with academic self-perception, internal locus of control, and interpersonal workplace skills such as teamwork, while cognitive skills dominate in technical and numerical domains. We assess the credibility of these associations, by combining Augmented Inverse Propensity Weighting with the framework of Cinelli and Hazlett (2020), quantifying how strong unobserved confounding would need to be to overturn our findings. This analysis reveals that perseverance’s associations with contemporaneous academic performance and locus of control beliefs show strong to moderate robustness. In contrast, associations with educational attainment and labour market outcomes are more fragile. Subgroup analysis reveals that perseverance functions as a compensatory mechanism in the face of childhood adversity, and it reinforces effort beliefs and labour market outcomes for males. Our findings would imply that policies promoting perseverance yield credible benefits for academic engagement and psychological well-being, but long-term economic gains requires interventions addressing educational access, financial barriers and labour market inequality.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究儿童毅力的早期决定因素及其对整个生命历程中教育程度和劳动力市场结果的预测能力。利用1970英国队列研究中教师评估的毅力，我们记录了认知技能、性别、早期健康状况和父母的影响（特别是母亲的生物因素和父亲的教育）是年龄毅力的最强预测因素10。毅力和认知技能对以后的结果表现出独特但互补的影响。毅力与学业自我认知、内部控制点和团队合作等人际工作场所技能密切相关，而认知技能在技术和数字领域占主导地位。我们通过将增强逆倾向权重与 Cinelli 和 Hazlett (2020) 的框架相结合来评估这些关联的可信度，量化推翻我们的发现需要多大程度的未观察到的混杂因素。这项分析表明，毅力与同期学业成绩和控制信念源泉的关联表现出强到中度的稳健性。相比之下，教育程度和劳动力市场结果之间的关联更为脆弱。亚组分析表明，毅力是面对童年逆境时的一种补偿机制，它强化了男性的努力信念和劳动力市场结果。我们的研究结果表明，促进毅力的政策可以为学术参与和心理健康带来可信的好处，但长期的经济收益需要采取干预措施来解决教育机会、财务障碍和劳动力市场不平等问题。

articles.title_en: The effects of the reform of the judicial map on the functioning of civil justice
articles.title_cn: 司法地图改革对民事司法运作的影响
articles.abstract_en: The paper evaluates the impact of the reform of the judicial map on the functioning of Italian civil justice. Implemented between 2013 and 2014, the reform abolished all branch offices and merged several small first-instance courts, substantially increasing the size of judicial districts and the scale at which civil justice services are provided. According to our findings, the reform led to a reduction in the demand for justice, plausibly due to higher access costs associated with increased distances to the courts. This decline was particularly pronounced in case types characterized by greater claimant discretion and lower expected stakes. On the supply side, the reform increased the number of cases resolved and reduced their average duration. These improvements were more pronounced in initially less efficient courts and in more complex case types, which benefited the most from the increased scale and specialization.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文评估了司法地图改革对意大利民事司法运作的影响。 2013至2014期间实施的改革取消了所有分支机构，并合并了几个小型第一法院，大大增加了司法管辖区的规模和提供民事司法服务的规模。根据我们的调查结果，改革导致了对正义的需求减少，这可能是由于与法院的距离增加相关的准入成本更高。这种下降在索赔人自由裁量权较大和预期风险较低的案件类型中尤其明显。在供给侧，改革增加了案件的解决数量并缩短了平均持续时间。这些改进在最初效率较低的法院和更复杂的案件类型中更为明显，这些法院从规模和专业化的扩大中获益最多。

articles.title_en: Peer institution networks, test-optional admission policies, and STEM major completions
articles.title_cn: 同行机构网络、考试可选录取政策和 STEM 专业完成情况
articles.abstract_en: To investigate the heterogeneous impacts of test-optional policies, I construct a network of private colleges based on their self-reported peer institutions and detect communities within it using a network science algorithm. I then estimate treatment effects by comparing adopters and non-adopters within the same community. I show how restricting to within-community comparisons drastically attenuates the severe pre-trends that arise when all untreated units serve as controls, suggesting that, within community, a parallel counterfactual trends assumption is satisfied. Overall, adoption substantially increases reported SAT scores, making adopting schools appear more selective, but decreases the share of bachelor’s degree completions in STEM, suggesting that marginally enrolled students are much less likely to complete a STEM degree than those they have displaced. Effects vary by community; at the most selective liberal arts colleges, policy adoption causes an 8 (26) percent decline in the share of all (under-represented minority) bachelor’s completions with a STEM major.
articles.abstract_cn: 为了调查可选考试政策的异质性影响，我根据私立大学自我报告的同行机构构建了一个网络，并使用网络科学算法检测其中的社区。然后，我通过比较同一社区内的采用者和非采用者来估计治疗效果。我展示了限制社区内比较如何极大地减弱当所有未经处理的单位作为对照时出现的严重预趋势，这表明在社区内，满足平行的反事实趋势假设。总体而言，收养大大提高了报告的 SAT 分数，使收养学校显得更具选择性，但降低了 STEM 学士学位的完成比例，这表明边缘入学的学生完成 STEM 学位的可能性远低于那些被取代的学生。影响因社区而异；在最挑剔的文理学院，政策的采用导致所有（代表性不足的少数）完成 STEM 专业学士学位的比例下降 8 (26)%。

articles.title_en: On the persistence of fluid identity: Insights from the decline of ethnic voting in Malawi
articles.title_cn: 关于流动身份的持久性：马拉维种族投票率下降的见解
articles.abstract_en: Recent empirical evidence suggesting the malleability of identity raises the critical question of whether an updated identity, adapted to new environments, endures and under what conditions. To address this question, I analyze the 2009 parliamentary election in Malawi, during which the results deviated from historical voting patterns along ethno-regional lines. Specifically, the southern-based Democratic Progressive Party unexpectedly gained overwhelming support across the country, reducing the salience of local ethnic groups and signaling a drive for unity among historically divided societies. By comparing constituencies where this party barely won or lost, I find that the victory significantly reduced citizens’ sense of ethnic instead of national identity—particularly in rural areas historically aligned with opposition parties. This effect persisted for several years, coinciding with improvements in certain public goods and services, but dissipated within seven years. Furthermore, there is no evidence that selective migration across ethnic homelands, strategic downplaying of ethnic attachments, or post-election disillusionment with the party explains the identity shift, though these alternatives cannot be conclusively dismissed. These findings suggest that while identity can swiftly respond to socioeconomic shocks that alter group salience, it may revert to its original state unless further shocks or policies reinforce the altered identity.
articles.abstract_cn: 最近的经验证据表明身份的可塑性提出了一个关键问题：适应新环境的更新身份是否能够持久以及在什么条件下持久。为了解决这个问题，我分析了马拉维的2009议会选举，选举结果偏离了民族地区的历史投票模式。具体来说，南方的民进党出人意料地在全国范围内获得了压倒性的支持，降低了当地少数民族的重要性，并标志着历史上分裂的社会之间团结的动力。通过比较该党几乎获胜或失败的选区，我发现这场胜利大大降低了公民的民族认同感，而不是国家认同感——特别是在历史上与反对党结盟的农村地区。这种影响持续了几年，与某些公共产品和服务的改善同时发生，但在七年内消失了。此外，没有证据表明选择性的跨族裔移民、战略性地淡化种族依恋或选举后对政党的幻灭可以解释身份的转变，尽管这些替代方案不能最终被排除。这些发现表明，虽然身份可以迅速应对改变群体显着性的社会经济冲击，但它可能会恢复到原来的状态，除非进一步的冲击或政策强化改变的身份。

articles.title_en: ‘Dead man working’: A place-based approach to occupational safety and health
articles.title_cn: “死人工作”：基于场所的职业安全与健康方法
articles.abstract_en: Despite increasingly stringent regulations, there has been a concerning stagnation in reducing workplace fatalities. Can place-based policy targeting help? By coupling machine learning techniques with comprehensive data from Italy, we develop a place-based approach to workplace fatalities. Harnessing accurate machine forecasts, we construct a granular risk map and compare it to the allocation of on-site work inspections and public subsidies for occupational safety, uncovering limited overlap. Counterfactual estimates reveal that current public policies are effective only in areas flagged as high-risk by ex-ante machine predictions. A back-of-the-envelope exercise based on these estimates suggests that machine-learning-based targeting could prevent approximately 70 workplace fatalities per year, equivalent to around 6% of annual deaths, generating substantial social benefits. AI-powered territorial targeting can reduce the incidence and economic burden of this chronic issue while lowering the costs of policy implementation.
articles.abstract_cn: 尽管法规日益严格，但在减少工作场所死亡人数方面却出现了令人担忧的停滞。基于地点的政策定位有帮助吗？通过将机器学习技术与意大利的综合数据相结合，我们开发了一种基于地点的工作场所死亡人数方法。利用准确的机器预测，我们构建了精细的风险图，并将其与现场工作检查和职业安全公共补贴的分配进行比较，发现有限的重叠。反事实估计表明，当前的公共政策仅在事前机器预测标记为高风险的领域有效。基于这些估计的粗略分析表明，基于机器学习的目标定位每年可以预防约 70 起工作场所死亡事故，相当于每年约 6% 的死亡事故，从而产生可观的社会效益。人工智能驱动的领土定位可以减少这一长期问题的发生率和经济负担，同时降低政策实施成本。

articles.title_en: Spatial heterogeneity in welfare reform success – local labour markets and single mothers’ earnings
articles.title_cn: 福利改革成效的空间异质性——地方劳动力市场与单身母亲的收入
articles.abstract_en: We study spatial variation in the responses of single mothers to a welfare reform in Australia which reduced the generosity of parenting support payments and increased the taper rates. We estimate the reform’s effect on earned income, using a large administrative dataset and applying regression discontinuity models separately to 87 distinct local labour markets. We can link the local reform effects to local unemployment rates and local wages and non-labour income. In sharp contrast to its objectives, the reform reduced labour earnings for single mothers; the effects were most pronounced in disadvantaged areas with weak labour market conditions. We also find that the reform did not induce migration, despite these costs of staying in place. Welfare reform imposed an extra cost on those living in more disadvantaged areas, and single mothers who cannot relocate bear a disproportionate burden.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了澳大利亚一项福利改革对单身母亲反应的地区差异，该改革减少了育儿支持支付的慷慨程度并提高了边际扣减率。我们使用大型行政数据集，并分别对87个不同的地方劳动力市场应用断点回归模型，估计了改革对劳动收入的影响。我们能够将地方改革效应与地方失业率、地方工资和非劳动收入联系起来。与改革目标形成鲜明对比的是，改革降低了单身母亲的劳动收入；在劳动力市场条件薄弱的弱势地区，影响最为显著。我们还发现，尽管留在原地有这些代价，改革并未引发迁移。福利改革给生活在更弱势地区的人带来了额外成本，而无法迁移的单身母亲承担了不成比例的负担。

articles.title_en: Running against windmills: Costly perseverance in long- and short-term goal pursuit
articles.title_cn: 逆风车奔跑：追求长期和短期目标的代价高昂的毅力
articles.abstract_en: This paper provides evidence of costly perseverance in the field. In a setting where consultants select and pursue projects autonomously, I show that perseverance, conditional on consistency of interest, is associated with fewer successfully completed projects as well as lower sales and commissions. Using rich firm data on individual job activity, I shed light on the task-specific behavioral mechanisms. Overall, perseverant consultants start fewer projects. In fast markets, the lower number of projects started is the main channel of costly perseverance; in slower markets, costs primarily arise from pursuing projects in a more isolated and uninformed way, as shown by an inefficient allocation of effort between stakeholders. The survey questions driving costly perseverance point to the consultants’ failure to incorporate negative signals and opportunity costs into their effort allocation. Using heterogeneity within and between consultants’ task assignment, I show that perseverance is more costly in exploration tasks as opposed to well-defined tasks characterized by mere exploitation.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文提供了该领域代价高昂的坚持的证据。在顾问自主选择和追求项目的环境中，我表明，以兴趣一致性为条件的毅力与成功完成的项目较少以及销售额和佣金较低有关。利用有关个人工作活动的丰富公司数据，我阐明了特定于任务的行为机制。总体而言，坚持不懈的顾问启动的项目较少。在快速市场中，开工项目数量较少是代价高昂的坚持的主要渠道；在发展缓慢的市场中，成本主要来自以更加孤立和不知情的方式开展项目，利益相关者之间的努力分配效率低下就表明了这一点。调查中提出的导致坚持不懈的成本高昂的问题表明，顾问未能将负面信号和机会成本纳入他们的工作分配中。利用顾问任务分配内部和之间的异质性，我表明，与仅以剥削为特征的明确定义的任务相比，在探索任务中坚持不懈的成本更高。

articles.title_en: Unity through rivalry: How competition mitigates social dilemmas
articles.title_cn: 通过竞争实现团结：竞争如何缓解社会困境
articles.abstract_en: We study whether competition between groups that yields no material rewards fosters within-group cooperation. In a laboratory experiment, pairs of subjects played an indefinitely repeated Prisoner’s Dilemma either in isolation or in a tournament against another pair, where winning conferred no monetary payoff. The competitive environment increased cooperation, and the effect strengthened over time as subjects gained experience. Exploiting the binary action space of the repeated game, we estimate participants’ strategies and find that the tournament reallocates play away from strategies that start with defection toward strategies that start with cooperation. This reallocation results in a shift from Always Defect to the least risky cooperative strategy, Grim. We complement the experiment with a simple tournament-based model that shows how non-monetary competition can shift equilibrium selection toward cooperative strategies.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究群体之间不产生物质奖励的竞争是否会促进群体内的合作。在一项实验室实验中，成对的受试者单独或在与另一对受试者的锦标赛中无限期地重复囚徒困境，获胜不会带来金钱回报。竞争环境增加了合作，随着受试者经验的积累，这种效果随着时间的推移而增强。利用重复游戏的二元动作空间，我们估计了参与者的策略，并发现锦标赛将游戏从以背叛开始的策略重新分配到以合作开始的策略。这种重新分配导致从“始终缺陷”转向风险最小的合作策略“Grim”。我们用一个简单的基于锦标赛的模型来补充实验，该模型展示了非货币竞争如何将均衡选择转向合作策略。

articles.title_en: Heuristic macroeconomic expectations
articles.title_cn: 启发式宏观经济预期
articles.abstract_en: To what extent are market participants’ predictions driven by intuition and subjective judgment? A lot more than we thought, according to the data. We propose a simple heuristic to explain how forecasters form predictions and find strong support in the Survey of Professional Forecasters (SPF). At the heart of the heuristic is base-rate neglect—a well-documented psychological tendency to underweight prior beliefs in favor of salient new information. Our result suggests that this overreaction to new information affects not only point forecasts but also how forecasters perceive uncertainty. As evidence, the estimated subjective uncertainty aligns closely with the cross-sectional disagreement among forecasters, a measure of macroeconomic uncertainty.
articles.abstract_cn: 市场参与者的预测在多大程度上是由直觉和主观判断驱动的？根据数据，比我们想象的要多得多。我们提出了一个简单的启发式方法来解释预测者如何形成预测并在专业预测者调查（SPF）中找到强有力的支持。启发式的核心是基本率忽视——一种有据可查的心理倾向，即低估先前的信念而偏向显着的新信息。我们的结果表明，这种对新信息的过度反应不仅影响点预测，而且影响预测者如何看待不确定性。作为证据，估计的主观不确定性与预测者之间的横截面分歧密切相关，这是宏观经济不确定性的衡量标准。

articles.title_en: Déjà Vu? When the Lab Mimics the Field
articles.title_cn: 似曾相识？当实验室模仿现场时
articles.abstract_en: We explore whether experiments involving strategic interactions yield the same conclusions regardless of the environment they take place in. We do so by comparing the behavior of a group of individuals when they play the same two-person zero-sum game in both a soccer stadium (the field) and a video game (the lab). We conduct our experiment with professional soccer players and inexperienced college students to determine if the abilities acquired in the field apply to both environments. Our findings show that while both groups behave consistently with the implications of mixed strategy equilibrium in the field, their behavior rejects the theory in the lab, where both groups seem to follow a reinforcement learning model.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们探讨涉及策略交互的实验是否会产生相同的结论，无论其发生的环境如何。我们通过比较一组人在足球场（场地）和电子游戏（实验室）中玩相同的二人零和游戏时的行为来实现这一点。我们对职业足球运动员和缺乏经验的大学生进行了实验，以确定在该领域获得的能力是否适用于这两种环境。我们的研究结果表明，虽然两个群体的行为与现场混合策略均衡的含义一致，但他们的行为拒绝了实验室中的理论，在实验室中，两个群体似乎都遵循强化学习模型。

articles.title_en: Inflation concerns and green product consumption: Evidence from a nationwide survey and a framed field experiment
articles.title_cn: 通货膨胀担忧和绿色产品消费：来自全国范围调查和框架性实地实验的证据
articles.abstract_en: Promoting green (usually more costly) product consumption is one essential element in building a sustainable society. In times of high inflation, not only budget constraints but also the fear that prices will continue to rise might limit the effectiveness of exerted efforts to promote sustainable behaviors. To test this suggestion, we conducted a Germany-wide survey with almost 1200 respondents, followed by a framed field experiment to confirm causality. Our proxy for green consumption is organic food purchases. Survey respondents’ stated organic purchasing behavior is positively correlated with concerns about climate change but negatively correlated with concerns about inflation. The latter result is driven by individuals with a below-median environmental attitude. In the framed field experiment, we use the priming method to manipulate the saliency of inflation concerns. Whereas sizably relaxing the budget constraint has no impact on the share of organic products in participants’ baskets, the priming significantly decreases the share of organic products for individuals with below-median environmental attitude. Using the same inflation priming in a subsequent survey experiment with around 1800 respondents, we find that high inflationary environments affect both the perception of organic being luxury products and the social norm of buying organic. Both effects are more pronounced for individuals with below-median environmental attitude and, hence, they are the likely mechanisms driving the negative effects on organic product consumption.
articles.abstract_cn: 促进绿色（通常成本更高）产品消费是建设可持续社会的基本要素。在高通胀时期，不仅预算限制，而且对价格将继续上涨的担忧都可能限制促进可持续行为的努力的有效性。为了检验这一建议，我们在德国范围内进行了一项调查，几乎有 1200 名受访者，随后进行了框架现场实验以确认因果关系。我们绿色消费的代表是购买有机食品。调查受访者表示，有机购买行为与对气候变化的担忧呈正相关，但与对通胀的担忧呈负相关。后一个结果是由环境态度低于中值的个人造成的。在框架现场实验中，我们使用启动方法来操纵通货膨胀担忧的显着性。虽然大幅放松预算限制对参与者购物篮中有机产品的份额没有影响，但启动显着降低了环境态度低于中值的个人的有机产品份额。在随后对大约 1800 名受访者进行的调查实验中，我们使用相同的通胀启动，发现高通胀环境既影响有机奢侈品的认知，也影响购买有机产品的社会规范。对于环境态度低于中值的个人来说，这两种影响更为明显，因此，它们可能是对有机产品消费产生负面影响的机制。

articles.title_en: Optimism, complementarity and welfare
articles.title_cn: 乐观、互补、福利
articles.abstract_en: This paper studies how a government’s disclosure of information based on short-term reputation concerns can distort agents’ investment decisions and welfare. Agents receive public information before deciding whether to invest, and their actions are strategic complements. There are efficient and inefficient governments, and the high productivity state is more likely under the efficient type. Governments know the state and make public reports with the goal of being perceived as efficient. This motivation leads the inefficient type to be optimistic in equilibrium, sending false reports of the high productivity state with positive probability, thus distorting agents’ beliefs. When productivity is actually high, this distortion reduces investment and welfare compared to a truthful disclosure policy. However, I show that the inefficient type can improve welfare in the low productivity state by sending false reports (there is a small economic boom), as long as the trust in the report is not too high. As the trust in the false report rises, the bias in the agents’ beliefs becomes so large that welfare starts to decrease (the boom might turn into a crisis).
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了政府基于短期声誉担忧而披露的信息如何扭曲代理人的投资决策和福利。代理人在决定是否投资之前会收到公共信息，他们的行动是战略补充。政府有高效和低效之分，高效型政府更可能处于高生产率状态。政府了解国家状况并发布公开报告，目的是让人们认为政府是高效的。这种动机导致低效率类型在均衡中保持乐观，以正概率发送高生产率状态的错误报告，从而扭曲代理人的信念。当生产率实际上很高时，与真实的披露政策相比，这种扭曲会减少投资和福利。然而，我表明，低效率类型可以通过发送虚假报告（有小规模的经济繁荣）来改善低生产率状态下的福利，只要对报告的信任度不是太高。随着对虚假报告的信任度上升，代理人信念的偏差变得如此之大，以至于福利开始减少（繁荣可能会变成危机）。

articles.title_en: Fueling the mind: How local gasoline prices shape household consumption
articles.title_cn: 激发灵感：当地汽油价格如何影响家庭消费
articles.abstract_en: We study how localized gasoline price shocks affect household consumption by linking high-frequency bank transaction data with station-level fuel prices. A 1% increase in local gasoline prices reduces monthly household spending by approximately 0.13%, even after controlling for national fuel price movements. We identify two mechanisms. First, spending declines are larger among fuel-dependent, low-liquidity households, consistent with a budget-constraint channel. Second, highly visible local price spikes reduce spending even among non-car households, consistent with a price-salience channel. We further show that localized gasoline price shocks amplify consumption inequality: low-income households with high fuel exposure experience the largest reductions, particularly in discretionary spending. Our findings show that localized energy price fluctuations shape household consumption through both financial constraints and behavioral responses to salient price signals.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们通过将高频银行交易数据与加油站燃油价格联系起来，研究局部汽油价格冲击如何影响家庭消费。即使在控制了全国燃油价格变动之后，当地汽油价格的 1% 上涨也会使每月家庭支出减少约 0.13%。我们确定了二机制。 第一，依赖燃料、低流动性的家庭的支出下降幅度更大，这与预算限制渠道一致。 第二，明显的当地价格飙升甚至减少了非汽车家庭的支出，这与价格显着渠道一致。我们进一步表明，局部汽油价格冲击加剧了消费不平等：高燃料暴露的低收入家庭经历了最大的减少，特别是在可自由支配支出方面。我们的研究结果表明，局部能源价格波动通过财务约束和对显着价格信号的行为反应来影响家庭消费。

articles.title_en: Governance, reputation, crises and recovery: An experiment
articles.title_cn: 治理、声誉、危机和恢复：一项实验
articles.abstract_en: We model and experimentally test the relationship between a firm’s reputation and its governance when firms can repair reputation damage through reform. Our model shows that conditions for establishing a reputation depend on whether control of firm operations is delegated to professional managers. Moreover, although the option to reform always dilutes firms’ incentive to commit to reputable behavior, delegation ameliorates the dilution. We assess the robustness of our model to behavioral deviations from optimal behavior through a laboratory experiment. The results of this experiment are directionally consistent with the model’s predictions.
articles.abstract_cn: 当企业可以通过改革修复声誉受损时，我们对企业声誉与其治理之间的关系进行建模和实验测试。我们的模型表明，建立声誉的条件取决于公司运营的控制权是否下放给职业经理人。此外，尽管改革的选择总是会削弱企业致力于信誉良好的行为的动力，但授权可以改善这种稀释。我们通过实验室实验评估模型对偏离最佳行为的稳健性。这个实验的结果与模型的预测方向一致。

articles.title_en: On migration gravity with status quo bias and job search frictions
articles.title_cn: 论移民引力与现状偏见和求职摩擦
articles.abstract_en: Why has internal migration remained low, even as advances in communication technologies have reduced information frictions in relocation decisions? This paper develops and estimates a spatial model of mobility that incorporates status quo bias in locational preferences, multilateral search frictions, and comoving regional unemployment. Using historical proxies for search frictions, we identify and recover county-level estimates of status quo bias across the United States. Status quo bias is spatially heterogeneous and highest in states containing large urban job centers. Translating these estimates into expected-utility, geographic-distance, and state-border equivalents indicates that variation in status quo bias generates migration frictions comparable to large geographic and institutional barriers. Status quo bias also exhibits strong persistence over time, a robust relationship to migration dynamics, and associations with a range of non-wage individual- and community-level correlates of locational preferences (e.g., housing, climate, and religious and political orientations). These patterns suggest that status quo bias partly reflects place-based preferences shaped by individuals’ residential histories.
articles.abstract_cn: 尽管通信技术的进步减少了搬迁决策中的信息摩擦，但为什么内部移民仍然很少？本文开发并估计了一个流动性的空间模型，该模型将位置偏好中的现状偏差、多边搜索摩擦和共同移动的区域失业纳入其中。使用搜索摩擦的历史代理，我们识别并恢复了美国各地县级现状偏差的估计。现状偏差在空间上存在异质性，并且在拥有大型城市就业中心的州中最为严重。将这些估计转化为预期效用、地理距离和国界等值表明，现状偏差的变化会产生与巨大的地理和制度障碍相当的移民摩擦。随着时间的推移，现状偏见也表现出强烈的持久性，与移民动态的密切关系，以及与一系列非工资个人和社区层面的位置偏好相关因素（例如住房、气候、宗教和政治取向）的关联。这些模式表明，现状偏见部分反映了个人居住历史所形成的基于地点的偏好。

articles.title_en: Cyclical behavior in large location games
articles.title_cn: 大型定位游戏中的周期性行为
articles.abstract_en: Location games capture important economic phenomena ranging from preemption to choice of bank leverage. We explore a parametric family of location games with many players, each facing a conflict between maximizing a fundamental payoff component and a relative (or quantile dependent) component. Using simulations and human subject experiments we show that, behaviorally, the stationary Nash equilibria in such games are terrible predictions of behavior and payoffs when players can freely adjust their locations. Instead, large cycles consistently emerge, in which behavior slowly grows bolder over time. This corresponds to progressively earlier timing in pre-emption games or to increasingly later timing in wars of attrition. When locations are maximally bold, namely at the end of the domain of Nash play, behavior quickly reverts to the peak fundamental and a new cycle begins.
articles.abstract_cn: 地点游戏捕捉了从抢占到银行杠杆选择等重要的经济现象。我们探索了具有许多玩家的参数化位置游戏系列，每个玩家都面临着最大化基本收益成分和相对（或分位数相关）成分之间的冲突。通过模拟和人体实验，我们表明，从行为角度来看，当玩家可以自由调整其位置时，此类游戏中的固定纳什均衡是对行为和收益的糟糕预测。相反，大周期不断出现，随着时间的推移，行为慢慢变得更加大胆。这对应于先发制人游戏中逐渐提前的时机或消耗战中越来越晚的时机。当位置达到最大程度时，即在纳什游戏领域的末尾，行为很快就会恢复到基本峰值，并开始新的循环。

articles.title_en: Ambiguity in performance pay: A real effort experiment
articles.title_cn: 绩效薪酬中的模糊性：一项真实努力实验
articles.abstract_en: Many incentive plans are inherently ambiguous, lacking an explicit mapping between performance and compensation. We study the effect of ambiguous incentive plans on willingness to accept contracts to do a real-effort task, what types of individuals (low vs. high ability) accept the contract, the probability of completing the task, and performance on the task. The effect of ambiguous incentives is negative on multiple dimensions. Piece rate contracts significantly improve performance relative to fixed wages, primarily due to selection. This positive effect is not present with ambiguous incentives because high ability individuals are no more likely than low ability individuals to accept a contract with ambiguity. Modest levels of ambiguity about the relationship between performance and compensation are sufficient to reduce the probability that subjects choose and complete the task. Information about individual ability at the task reduces the probability that subjects choose and complete the task, but this is primarily due to decreased overconfidence rather than a reduction of uncertainty.
articles.abstract_cn: 许多激励计划本质上具有模糊性，缺乏绩效与薪酬之间的明确映射。我们研究了模糊激励计划对接受真实努力任务合同的意愿、接受合同的个体类型（低能力与高能力）、完成任务的可能性以及任务绩效的影响。模糊激励在多个维度上产生负面影响。计件工资合同相对于固定工资显著提高了绩效，这主要归因于选择效应。这种积极效应在模糊激励下并不存在，因为高能力个体接受含模糊性合同的可能性并不高于低能力个体。绩效与薪酬之间关系的适度模糊性足以降低受试者选择并完成该任务的可能性。关于个体在任务中能力的信息降低了受试者选择并完成任务的可能性，但这主要归因于过度自信的减少，而非不确定性的降低。

articles.title_en: The dictatorial public goods game
articles.title_cn: 独裁公共品博弈
articles.abstract_en: We propose a novel game, the Dictatorial Public Goods Game, to study the interplay between collective resource generation and centralized provision of public goods. After making choices in a standard Voluntary Contribution Mechanism (VCM), one player is selected from the group to administrate the contributions: either provide the public good or expropriate the collected resources for personal gain. We find that adding this centralized mechanism reduces efficiency compared to the standard VCM. Although higher contributions increase the material incentive to expropriate, they lead to more provision. Thus, pro-social choices in the contribution and in the provision stages act as complements, reflecting the generation of social capital in the group. Administrators tend to provide more when the statutory default is expropriation rather than provision. This counter status-quo effect is in line with the standard provision-maintenance gap in the literature, but is not explained by the theoretical arguments typically invoked to explain such framing effects.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一种新颖的博弈，即独裁公共品博弈，以研究集体资源生成与公共品集中供给之间的相互作用。在标准自愿贡献机制（VCM）中做出选择后，从群体中选出一名玩家来管理贡献：要么提供公共品，要么将收集的资源挪作私用。我们发现，与标准VCM相比，增加这种集中机制会降低效率。尽管更高的贡献增加了挪用的物质激励，但它们导致了更多的供给。因此，贡献阶段和供给阶段的亲社会行为是互补的，反映了群体中社会资本的生成。当法定默认是挪用而非供给时，管理者倾向于提供更多。这种反现状效应与文献中标准的供给-维护差距一致，但并未由通常用来解释此类框架效应的理论论点所解释。

articles.title_en: Democracy and pro-market sentiments
articles.title_cn: 民主和亲市场情绪
articles.abstract_en: This study identifies 44 democratic transitions from 1980–2023 and estimates their effect on pro-market sentiments using a stacked difference-in-differences design. Democratic transitions reduce pro-market sentiments by 0.345 standard deviations on average. Yet the average masks a striking dynamic: a honeymoon spike more than four times the magnitude of the average decline, which reverses within two years. Cases of democratic deepening, where existing democracies further strengthened democratic governance, exhibit similar dynamics. The pattern survives a direct mean reversion test: countries with high and low baseline sentiments both exhibit the honeymoon spike. Falsification tests confirm the effect is specific to market attitudes, not a generic attitudinal shift. Declining beliefs in private ownership drive the negative medium-term effect even as acceptance of personal responsibility rises, suggesting ideological reconfiguration rather than uniform attitude decay. These findings indicate that the ideological foundations of market economies do not automatically consolidate alongside democratic institutions.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究确定了 44-1980 的2023民主转型，并使用叠加的双重差异设计估计了它们对亲市场情绪的影响。民主转型平均会降低亲市场情绪0.345个标准差。然而，平均数掩盖了一个惊人的动态：蜜月期峰值超过平均下降幅度的四倍，并在二年内逆转。现有民主国家进一步加强民主治理的民主深化案例也表现出类似的动态。该模式经受住了直接均值回归测试：基线情绪高和低的国家都表现出蜜月高峰。证伪测试证实，这种影响是特定于市场态度的，而不是普遍的态度转变。即使个人责任的接受程度提高，对私有制的信念下降也会带来负面的中期影响，这表明意识形态的重新配置，而不是统一的态度衰退。这些发现表明，市场经济的意识形态基础不会自动与民主制度一起巩固。

articles.title_en: Sanctions without sanctimony: Why do states impose sanctions?
articles.title_cn: 没有道义的制裁：国家为何要实施制裁？
articles.abstract_en: We examine the political and economic effects of sanctions against their stated goals to justify them. We find null or negative effects on every outcome that we test. Given the ubiquity and persistence of economic sanctions as international policy tools, and given the substantial costs of designing, maintaining, and enforcing sanctions, this seems paradoxical. Why would contemporary nation states impose sanctions with no discernibly beneficial effects? We highlight the behavioral complexity inherent to the context of international relations as a viable explanation for sanctions’ lack of measurable efficacy. Designing and enforcing effective sanctions with precision and accuracy is a tangibly more complex challenge beyond conventional punitive deterrence. Using public choice analysis, we explain how sanctions benefit certain special interests and government authorities. The persistent use of these economic tools for statecraft can ultimately be explained by public choice.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究制裁对其既定目标的政治和经济影响，以证明其合理性。我们发现对我们测试的每个结果都没有影响或负面影响。鉴于经济制裁作为国际政策工具的普遍性和持久性，以及设计、维持和执行制裁的巨大成本，这似乎是自相矛盾的。为什么当代民族国家会实施没有明显有益效果的制裁？我们强调国际关系背景下固有的行为复杂性，以此作为制裁缺乏可衡量效力的可行解释。与传统的惩罚性威慑相比，精确和准确地设计和执行有效的制裁显然是一项更加复杂的挑战。通过公共选择分析，我们解释了制裁如何使某些特殊利益和政府当局受益。这些经济工具持续用于治国之道最终可以用公共选择来解释。

articles.title_en: On the stability of social risk preferences for health and wealth
articles.title_cn: 健康与财富领域社会风险偏好的稳定性
articles.abstract_en: This study investigates the temporal and contextual stability of social risk preferences across health and wealth, focusing on both gains and losses. Using a large representative Dutch panel, we replicated the experimental design of Attema et al. (2023) which elicited social risk preferences through allocation decisions involving two anonymous recipients under risk. The design allows us to distinguish three dimensions of preferences: risk preferences, inequality aversion, and social risk preferences arising from trade-offs between risk and inequality, corresponding to utilitarian, ex-ante, and ex-post perspectives on social welfare. At the aggregate level, the main patterns documented in the original study are largely replicated: inequality aversion is prevalent and risk aversion is weaker in the loss domain than in the gain domain. At the individual level, however, stability is more limited. Test–retest correlations are positive but modest, and the proportion of identical choices across waves varies across domains and framings. Parametric estimations further reveal substantial heterogeneity in social risk preferences. A latent-class analysis identifies utilitarian preferences as the largest group, followed by ex-post and ex-ante perspectives. Overall, the results highlight the coexistence of persistence, contextual effects, and heterogeneity in social risk preferences.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究考察健康与财富领域社会风险偏好在时间和情境上的稳定性，同时关注收益与损失。利用具有代表性的大型荷兰面板数据，我们复现了 Attema 等人（2023）的实验设计，通过在风险条件下对两名匿名接受者作出分配决策来识别社会风险偏好。该设计能够区分风险偏好、不平等厌恶，以及风险与不平等权衡所产生的社会风险偏好，分别对应社会福利的功利主义、事前和事后视角。在总体层面，原研究记录的主要模式大体得到复现：不平等厌恶普遍存在，损失情境中的风险厌恶弱于收益情境。然而在个体层面，稳定性较为有限。重测相关性为正但幅度不高，不同轮次作出相同选择的比例也随领域和表述框架而变化。参数估计进一步显示社会风险偏好存在显著异质性。潜在类别分析发现，功利主义偏好是最大群体，其次是事后和事前视角。总体而言，结果表明社会风险偏好同时具有持续性、情境效应和异质性。

articles.title_en: Strategy method effects in centipede games: An optimal design approach
articles.title_cn: 策略方法在蜈蚣博弈中的效果：一种优化设计方法
articles.abstract_en: We explore the twin questions of when and how the strategy method creates behavioral distortions in the elicitation of choices in laboratory studies of sequential games. While such distortions have been widely documented, the theoretical forces driving these distortions remain poorly understood. In this paper, we compare behavior in six optimally designed centipede games, implemented under three different choice elicitation methods: the direct response method, the reduced strategy method and the full strategy method. These methods elicit behavioral strategies, reduced strategies, and complete strategies, respectively. We find significant behavioral differences across these elicitation methods—differences that cannot be explained by standard game theory, but are consistent with the predictions of the Dynamic Cognitive Hierarchy solution (Lin and Palfrey, 2024), combined with payoff dependent stochastic choice.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们探讨了两个问题：在顺序博弈的实验室研究中，策略方法何时以及如何在诱导选择过程中产生行为扭曲。尽管这种扭曲已被广泛记录，但驱动这些扭曲的理论力量仍然知之甚少。在本文中，我们比较了六优化设计的蜈蚣游戏的行为，这些游戏在三不同的选择诱导方法下实现：直接响应法、简化策略法和完整策略法。这些方法分别引发行为策略、简化策略和完整策略。我们发现这些启发方法存在显着的行为差异，这些差异无法用标准博弈论解释，但与动态认知层次解决方案（Lin 和 Palfrey，2024）的预测相一致，并结合收益相关的随机选择。

articles.title_en: Virtual observability in sequential play
articles.title_cn: 序贯博弈中的虚拟可观察性
articles.abstract_en: When players make sequential decisions that are unobservable to one another, their behavior can nonetheless be influenced by knowing who moves first. This sequential structure, often referred to as “virtual observability,” suggests that timing alone can shape expectations and choices, even when no information is revealed. The original notion of virtual observability, however, is an equilibrium refinement based on the timing structure and has no bite in games with unique equilibria. To study whether timing may still matter in such environments, we introduce General Virtual Observability (GVO) as a conceptual framework that extends the intuition of virtual observability beyond equilibrium selection. Guided by this framework, we experimentally examine whether the timing of unobserved moves affects behavior in two games with unique Nash equilibria: the Traveler’s Dilemma and the Trust Game. We find that in the sequential Traveler’s Dilemma without observability, first movers behave closer to the Nash equilibrium prediction than in the simultaneous version, whereas timing without observability has no effect on behavior in the Trust Game.
articles.abstract_cn: 当参与者做出彼此不可观察的序贯决策时，他们的行为仍可能因知晓谁先行动而受到影响。这种序贯结构通常被称为“虚拟可观察性”，表明即使没有信息被揭示，仅凭时机本身就能塑造预期和选择。然而，虚拟可观察性的原始概念是基于时机结构的均衡精炼，在具有唯一均衡的博弈中没有约束力。为了研究在这种环境中时机是否仍然重要，我们引入了广义虚拟可观察性（GVO）作为概念框架，将虚拟可观察性的直觉扩展到均衡选择之外。在此框架指导下，我们通过实验检验了不可观察行动的时机是否影响两个具有唯一纳什均衡的博弈中的行为：旅行者困境和信任博弈。我们发现，在不可观察的序贯旅行者困境中，先行动者的行为比同时版本更接近纳什均衡预测，而在信任博弈中，无观察的时机对行为没有影响。

articles.title_en: Deliberate stochastic choice: A mouse-tracking experiment
articles.title_cn: 故意随机选择：小鼠追踪实验
articles.abstract_en: Stochastic choice (SC)—the tendency to select different options across repeated presentations of the same choice set—is well documented, yet its cognitive mechanisms remain debated. We combine mouse-tracking with the experimental design of Agranov and Ortoleva (2017), comparing distant and sequential repetitions of lottery choices. We show that the Area Under the Curve (AUC) provides a more informative process-level measure of SC than response times (RT). RT decline after the first presentation in both repetition structures, but do not reliably predict trial-level switching. AUC remains stable across distant repetitions while drops sharply after the first sequential choice, suggesting that explicit repetitions allow participants to plan subsequent choices at first and execute them more directly thereafter. AUC also reveals heterogeneity hidden by aggregate choice data: among regular participants, SC does not increase AUC in distant repeats, but produces larger and more curved trajectories in sequential repeats, suggesting a signature of cautiousness under explicit randomization. Among dominance violators, SC is instead accompanied by larger and more erratic trajectories, suggesting error-driven variability. Overall, SC appears to combine a predominantly deliberate component with a smaller boundedly rational component.
articles.abstract_cn: 随机选择（SC）——在同一选择集的重复呈现中选择不同选项的倾向——已有充分记录，但其认知机制仍然存在争议。我们将鼠标跟踪与 Agranov 和 Ortoleva (2017) 的实验设计结合起来，比较彩票选择的远程重复和连续重复。我们表明，曲线下面积 (AUC) 提供了比响应时间 (RT) 更丰富的过程级 SC 度量。在两种重复结构中出现 第一 后，RT 均下降，但不能可靠地预测试验级别的切换。 AUC 在远距离重复中保持稳定，而在 第一 顺序选择后急剧下降，这表明显式重复允许参与者在 第一 处计划后续选择，并在此后更直接地执行它们。 AUC 还揭示了聚合选择数据隐藏的异质性：在常规参与者中，SC 不会增加远处重复中的 AUC，但会在连续重复中产生更大、更弯曲的轨迹，这表明在显式随机化下的谨慎特征。在优势违规者中，SC 反而伴随着更大、更不稳定的轨迹，这表明存在错误驱动的变异性。总体而言，SC 似乎将主要的故意成分与较小的有限理性成分结合起来。
