articles.title_en: The affective cost of spending: neuroeconomic and experimental evidence on the pain of paying
articles.title_cn: 支出的情感成本：关于支付之痛的神经经济学和实验证据
articles.abstract_en: The metaphor of "pain of paying" has shaped behavioral economics for decades, yet direct evidence that spending money elicits literal pain remains elusive. Building on Camerer et al.'s (2005) neuroeconomic framework, we present converging evidence from two studies demonstrating that payment decisions activate affective pain-processing circuits. In a correlational pilot study, we use fMRI during incentive-compatible purchase decisions to show that activity in the anterior insula—a key region in affective pain processing—correlates parametrically with price magnitude. Critically, we find that paying with money activates affective but not somatosensory pain networks in the brain, whereas paying with electric shocks activates both. In the main study, we establish causality through a novel reverse-placebo paradigm in which participants believed they had taken pain-modulating drugs. Only affective pain enhancing placebos influenced valuation: participants given affective pain “enhancers” exhibited higher willingness to pay than those given affective “relievers,” though neither condition differed significantly from the untreated control. These findings provide the first causal evidence that the pain of paying constitutes a genuine affective experience that shapes economic valuation. We discuss implications for models of consumer choice, mental accounting, and behavioral policy interventions aimed at improving financial decision-making.
articles.abstract_cn: 几十年来，“支付之痛”的比喻一直影响着行为经济学，但花钱确实会带来痛苦的直接证据仍然难以捉摸。基于 Camerer 等人 (2005) 的神经经济框架，我们提出了来自 二 研究的综合证据，证明付款决策激活情感疼痛处理回路。在一项相关试点研究中，我们在激励相容的购买决策中使用功能磁共振成像来表明前岛叶（情感疼痛处理的关键区域）的活动与价格幅度呈参数相关。重要的是，我们发现用金钱支付会激活大脑中的情感网络，但不会激活体感疼痛网络，而用电击支付则会激活这两种网络。在主要研究中，我们通过一种新颖的反向安慰剂范式建立了因果关系，其中参与者相信他们服用了疼痛调节药物。只有情感疼痛增强安慰剂会影响评估：给予情感疼痛“增强剂”的参与者比给予情感“缓解剂”的参与者表现出更高的支付意愿，尽管这两种情况与未经治疗的对照组没有显着差异。这些发现提供了第一因果证据，表明支付的痛苦构成了一种真正的情感体验，可以塑造经济估值。我们讨论了消费者选择模型、心理账户和旨在改善金融决策的行为政策干预的影响。

articles.title_en: What doesn’t kill you makes you shorter: The effect of prenatal air pollution on height in adulthood
articles.title_cn: 杀不死你的东西会让你变矮：产前空气污染对成年身高的影响
articles.abstract_en: This study investigates the causal effect of prenatal air pollution on height in adulthood. We employ a two-stage least squares model, using thermal inversions as an instrumental variable for identification. Leveraging data from a nationally representative sample in China, the results show that an increase of 1 μg/m3 in PM2.5 concentrations during gestation reduces height in adulthood by 0.4 cm and normalized height scores by 0.07 standard deviations. These adverse effects on height are primarily driven by exposure to air pollution during the first and second trimesters of pregnancy. Furthermore, the results show that exposure to air pollution after birth does not significantly impact adult height. The mechanism analysis indicates that income reductions that are associated with air pollution are unlikely to be the main pathway through which prenatal air pollution affects long-term height outcomes. Instead, disruptions to maternal health during pregnancy appear to be the dominant mechanism.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究调查了产前空气污染对成年身高的因果影响。我们采用二级最小二乘模型，使用热反演作为识别的工具变量。利用中国全国代表性样本的数据，结果表明，妊娠期间 PM2.1 浓度增加 5 μg/m3，成年期身高会降低 0.4 厘米，标准化身高得分会降低 0.07 个标准差。这些对身高的不利影响主要是由于怀孕第一和第二三个月期间接触空气污染造成的。此外，结果表明，出生后暴露于空气污染不会显着影响成年身高。机制分析表明，与空气污染相关的收入减少不太可能是产前空气污染影响长期身高结果的主要途径。相反，怀孕期间孕产妇健康的破坏似乎是主要机制。

articles.title_en: Training time, robots and technological unemployment
articles.title_cn: 培训时间、机器人和技术性失业
articles.abstract_en: We document that labor training requirements for high-skilled occupations increased in the U.S. from 2006 to 2019. These greater training requirements reduce the extent to which workers displaced from shrinking occupations can relocate to expanding (high-skilled) occupations, thus potentially affecting both the equilibrium occupational structure and the unemployment level. We build a quantitative model in which labor is displaced by task-replacing technological change embodied in robots (“tasks shock”) and the extent of occupational switching depends on the destination occupations’ training requirements. We find that: (i) task-displacing technological change increases steady-state unemployment, but it reduces unemployment along the transition; (ii) in contrast, a comparable shock to capital embodied technological change produces larger unemployment rates with respect to the tasks shock, both in the transition and the steady state; and (iii) greater training requirements in high-skilled occupations increase steady-state unemployment and affect the occupational structure along the transition, but the shape of their effect depends on the size of the technological shock
articles.abstract_cn: 我们记录了美国高技能职业的劳动培训要求从2006增加到2019。这些更高的培训要求降低了从收缩职业中流离失所的工人重新安置到扩张（高技能）职业的程度，从而可能影响均衡职业结构和失业率。我们建立了一个定量模型，其中劳动力被机器人所体现的任务替代技术变革所取代（“任务冲击”），职业转换的程度取决于目的地职业的培训要求。我们发现：（i）任务转移的技术变革增加了稳态失业率，但在转型过程中减少了失业率； (ii) 相比之下，无论是在转型状态还是在稳定状态，与任务冲击相比，技术变革对资本的类似冲击都会产生更大的失业率； (iii) 高技能职业的更高培训要求会增加稳态失业率并影响转型过程中的职业结构，但其影响的形式取决于技术冲击的规模

articles.title_en: Poisoned air, shortened lives: PM2.5 exposure and premature mortality in Southern European cities
articles.title_cn: 毒化空气，缩短寿命：南欧城市PM2.5暴露与过早死亡
articles.abstract_en: This study examines the causal effect of PM2.5 air pollution exposure on premature mortality in Southern European cities from 2010 to 2018. We leverage local variations in precipitation and wind speed as a source of random variation in PM2.5 exposure. Using the Two-Sample Two-Stage Least Squares (TS2SLS) estimator to reconcile monitoring station-level and city-level data, our findings reveal a statistically significant increase in premature mortality caused by PM2.5. According to our preferred specification, a 1% increase in PM2.5 causes a 0.82% rise in the under-65 mortality rate and a 0.93% rise in the infant mortality rate. The results are robust to alternative specifications. The most affected populations are those residing in urban areas (relative to suburban areas) and those living in cities located in richer regions (as opposed to poorer ones). We also examine the role of additional pollutants, finding further evidence for the importance of particulate matter.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究考察了2010年至2018年南欧城市PM2.5空气污染暴露对过早死亡的因果效应。我们利用降水和风速的局部变化作为PM2.5暴露的随机变异来源。使用两样本两阶段最小二乘（TS2SLS）估计量来协调监测站级和城市级数据，我们的研究结果显示PM2.5导致的过早死亡在统计上显著增加。根据我们的首选规格，PM2.5每增加1%，65岁以下死亡率上升0.82%，婴儿死亡率上升0.93%。结果对替代规格具有稳健性。受影响最大的人群是居住在城市地区（相对于郊区）以及居住在较富裕地区城市（相对于较贫困地区）的人群。我们还考察了其他污染物的作用，进一步证明了颗粒物的重要性。

articles.title_en: Logrolling and the power of single-mindedness
articles.title_cn: 互助和一心一意的力量
articles.abstract_en: We study a committee that decides on multiple issues and determines, for each, both the direction and the extent of reform, assuming that reform intensity is proportional to net support and that agents are ex ante symmetric. Within this environment, we investigate how logrolling shapes policy outcomes. We establish three main results. First, an essentially unique competitive equilibrium always exists. Second, logrolling improves the welfare of every committee member, and actually implements the Nash bargaining solution. Third, when the number of issues is sufficiently large, a single-minded delegate fully determines policy within her domain of interest. That is, the current analysis: (i) identifies a setting in which vote-trading may lead to stable outcomes, (ii) uncovers a link between a familiar political practice and a prominent welfare benchmark, and (iii) pins down one mechanism through which single-issue minorities may acquire disproportionate influence in representative democracies.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究一个委员会，该委员会决定多个问题，并为每个问题确定改革的方向和程度，假设改革强度与净支持成正比，并且代理人是事前对称的。在这种环境下，我们研究了互助如何影响政策结果。我们建立了三主要结果。 第一，本质上独特的竞争均衡始终存在。 第二，logrolling提高了每个委员会成员的福利，真正实现了纳什讨价还价的解决方案。 第三，当问题数量足够多时，一心一意的代表完全可以在她感兴趣的领域内决定政策。也就是说，当前的分析：（i）确定了一种选票交易可能导致稳定结果的环境，（ii）揭示了熟悉的政治实践与突出的福利基准之间的联系，以及（iii）确定了一机制，通过该机制，单一问题的少数群体可以在代议制民主国家中获得不成比例的影响力。

articles.title_en: Adversarial bargaining with exogenous shocks
articles.title_cn: 与外部冲击的对抗性讨价还价
articles.abstract_en: This paper examines equilibrium strategies in adversarial bargaining, which are negotiations where one party demands concessions under threat of initiating a destructive conflict. We develop a multi-period model incorporating both endogenous conflict decisions and the risk of exogenous conflict, analyzing how outcomes depend on threat credibility and patience levels. Three types of equilibrium emerge: impatient aggressors extract the maximum concession through credible deterministic threats; highly patient scenarios feature probabilistic threats where exogenous risk creates bargaining power; and intermediate patience levels produce mixed-strategy threats. We distinguish between scenarios where conflict benefits the aggressor versus where conflict harms both parties, leading to brinkmanship. Our results reveal a striking non-monotonic relationship between patience and equilibrium demands when conflict benefits the aggressor.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了对抗性谈判中的均衡策略，在这种谈判中，一一方在发起破坏性冲突的威胁下要求让步。我们开发了一个包含内生冲突决策和外生冲突风险的多时期模型，分析结果如何取决于威胁可信度和耐心水平。 三均衡的类型出现：不耐烦的侵略者通过可信的确定性威胁获得最大的让步；高度耐心的场景具有概率威胁，其中外生风险创造了讨价还价能力；中等耐心水平会产生混合策略威胁。我们区分冲突对攻击者有利的情况和冲突对双方都造成伤害并导致边缘政策的情况。我们的结果揭示了当冲突对侵略者有利时，耐心与平衡需求之间存在显着的非单调关系。
